name: Kesh
traits: Dexterity +2. Medium, walking speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Proficient in Survival. Common, Keshian and one chosen language.

Minor Alteration grants alter appearance once per long rest at 1st level. The visual disguise leaves the kesh’s black eyes unchanged. At levels 4, 9 and 14, each milestone adds one use and an hour to the duration. All uses return on a long rest.
Memory Meld grants shared vision once per long rest, using Charisma to channel it.
Noble Kesh, or Shavnali, add +1 Charisma, proficiency with the long blade and energy staff, and another language.
Star Kesh, or Kelamir, add +1 Intelligence and one artisan tool proficiency. Add proficiency to Intelligence (Astrophysics) checks, or double it if already proficient.

name: Matokai
traits: Constitution +2. Medium, walking speed 30 ft. Common, Matokai and Bahtera. Claws give unarmed strikes 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage.
Firetail adds +1 Intelligence and fire resistance. Use the Constitution-based fire lance talent once per long rest. It starts at rank 1 and rises to ranks 2, 3 and 4 at levels 6, 11 and 16.
Skytalon adds +1 Wisdom and Insight proficiency. As a bonus action, double walking speed and jumping distance for 1 minute, once per short or long rest.

Stonefang adds +1 Strength. As a bonus action, gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing until the start of the next turn. Uses per short or long rest increase from one to two at level 6 and three at level 11.
Waveclaw adds +1 Charisma, air and water breathing, darkvision 60 ft. and cold resistance.

name: Promethean
traits: Dexterity +2. Medium, walking speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Common and one chosen language. Select a playable lineage after the Chrysalis.
Crescent adds +1 Intelligence and Perception proficiency. Gain advantage on saves against mind-altering or hallucinatory effects of toxins or esper powers.

Fire-Blooded adds +1 Strength, advantage on saves against poison and disease, and resistance to poison damage. Maximum Effort doubles proficiency on a chosen Athletics or Acrobatics check once per long rest. Add one use at levels 5, 9 and 14.

name: Valna
traits: Dexterity +2 and Wisdom +1. Medium, walking speed 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft. Common and Valna.
Claws grant a 20-ft. climb speed while free of heavy armor. Unarmed claw strikes deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing.
Catlike Agility adds 10 ft. of movement in any direction when taking the Disengage action.
Empathic Sense adds double proficiency to Wisdom (Insight) checks for a creature’s mood or general attitude, replacing any proficiency bonus that would otherwise apply.
Survival Training grants two proficiencies chosen from Perception, Stealth, Survival and Xenobiology.
